label: Script-01
title: KOLEKSI LENGKAP 30 SET PROMPT BERSIRI 3 SCENE (EDISI KUCING 3D & STORYBOARD EMAS PUBLIC GOLD)

guide.p: Dokumen ini menyediakan 30 set prompt bersiri 3 scene berangkai (total 90 babak video 10 saat) yang dipadankan secara khusus dengan 30 persona dan topik kewangan daripada koleksi skrip pendek asal. Setiap set mengikut arka penceritaan berstruktur yang terbukti menarik perhatian audiens media sosial (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts):

items: Scene 1 (Animasi 3D Kucing - Konflik & Masalah): Memaparkan realiti cabaran kewangan, tekanan ekonomi harian, atau tabiat boros masyarakat Malaysia melalui gelagat comel dan ekspresif keluarga kucing Calico (Zero Gold Rule).

Scene 2 (Animasi 3D Kucing - Kesedaran & Tindakan Berhemat): Keluarga kucing mencapai titik perubahan (turning point), belajar berhemat, mengurus bajet keluarga, atau meraih kelegaan tanpa hutang (Zero Gold Rule).

Scene 3 (Live-Action Wanita Berhijab - Solusi Emas Public Gold): Hos wanita Malaysia berhijab kemas dengan aurat sempurna dan handsocks penuh menyambung mesej keluarga kucing secara langsung kepada audiens, memberikan solusi simpanan emas fizikal Public Gold (8-Panel Storyboard A4 + Video Prompt 10s Lip-Sync).

Giliran 6 Gaya Bukaan Scene 3: Gaya pembukaan Scene 3 digilirkan secara seimbang tanpa mengulang gaya yang sama tiga kali berturut-turut: Situasi Harian, Pengakuan Silap, Jawab Bantahan, Soalan + Reveal, Milestone, dan Sasaran Persona.

guide.p: Kucing betina dewasa Calico tiga warna (oren-halia, tompok hitam pekat, dada & kaki putih bersih, mata hijau zamrud). Penyayang, cermat, bijak mengurus perbelanjaan rumah, dan sentiasa melindungi anak-anak.
Kucing jantan dewasa tegap, bulu kelabu perak belang arang (silver-grey charcoal tabby), mata madu keemasan, misai tebal, ekspresi santai, macho, berkarisma, dan berjiwa pelindung keluarga.

Oren (belang oren-halia lincah, mata biru nilam), Kelabu (belang perak-arang pemerhati, mata madu), Coklat (anak damit marmar coklat berbedung rapi, mata hazel), Putih (anak kucing putih bersih, mata kuning).

Wanita Malaysia berusia lewat 20-an hingga awal 30-an, wajah ramah berwibawa, bertudung kemas, berkaca mata. Pakaian longgar sopan dengan 3 klausa handsocks wajib (menutup pergelangan tangan sepenuhnya, tiada lengan pendek/tiga suku).

Scene 1 & 2: Rumah teres / rumah kayu kampung / kedai makan kucing Malaysia yang realistik. Scene 3: Veranda / patio taman kediaman moden Malaysia. Emas fizikal Public Gold (1g, 5g, 10g, 20g, 100g, Dinar) berkilau di bawah cahaya matahari.

Main Character / Subject
A friendly, professional Malaysian woman in her late 20s with an engaging, trustworthy aura, wearing modern neat hijab and chic contemporary modest wear. Her outer top always has full-length long sleeves reaching all the way down to the wrists — never three-quarter, never rolled up, never pushed back. She speaks directly to the camera with warmth and conviction. Maintain exact same face, glasses, hijab styling, and outfit across all panels.

Action: The woman stands gracefully on a sunlit veranda, smiling warmly as she holds an empty paper pay-slip envelope.
Emotion: Relatable and welcoming.

Emotion: Clear and inspiring.

Dialogue: "Kuncikan RM100 dalam akaun emas,"

Time: 0:05–0:06.25

6. Unique Angle - TOP SHOT (overhead)

Emotion: Resolute, motivating, warm.

- Total runtime: 10 seconds across exactly 8 distinct panels.
- Maintain identical Malaysian woman character in modest hijab throughout.
- Sleeves stay full length down to the wrists in every panel, with plain inner handsocks showing only as a narrow cuff at the wrists. Never three-quarter sleeves, never rolled-up sleeves, never bare forearms.
- All panels take place in the bright home veranda setting.
- Ensure the narrative flow is clear and emotionally engaging.
- Dialogues must be short and punchy to fit 1.25s per panel speech.
- Do not include a piggy bank anywhere in the storyboard.
